videos.title: Jack Hanna's Into the Wild
videos.description: Longtime zookeeper Jack Hanna hosts this Emmy-winning show that takes viewers on a journey around the world to showcase animals in their natural habitats. In addition to showing footage of the creatures and giving information about the places where they live, "Into the Wild" discusses the protection and conservation of endangered species. Among the locations visited are remote jungles, deserts, oceans and forests.

videos.description: Pregame analysis, along with highlights from other college football games around the country.

videos.title: College Football
videos.description: The North Carolina Tar Heels (5-5, 2-4 ACC) visit the Virginia Cavaliers (5-5, 3-4). Virginia is fresh off a 36-7 win over California, while North Carolina fell 16-14 to Louisville and looks to Billy Edwards Jr., who has 18 touchdowns this season.

videos.title: College Football
videos.description: The Northern Illinois Huskies visit the North Dakota State Bison in NCAA Division I FBS. Northern Illinois enters on a ten-game skid with Taron Dickens, while North Dakota State rides a two-game win streak with Nathan Hayes in MWC play.

videos.title: College Football
videos.description: The Colorado State Rams visit the Fresno State Bulldogs for an NCAA Division I FBS game. The Colorado State Rams enter on a three-game skid with Hauss Hejny, while the Fresno State Bulldogs enter on a two-game skid with Jayden Mandal in Pac-12.

videos.title: TruCountry
videos.description: "TruCountry" showcases some of America's top country artists, who perform in front of crowds at the Circle T Arena in Hamilton, Texas. The half-hour episodes feature down-home country music that represents the country's musical heritage and the genre's roots. Both veteran singers and young, up-and-coming artists perform their hits. Among the acts that have been featured on the show are Heather Myles, Leona Williams, James Hand, Jake Hooker and Darrell McCall.
